pages.title: Shades
text: The dead of the March walk where they died. Every shade has **25 health** and no armour, and hits for **5**, but each fights its own way.
Each drops **1 to 2** of its reagent, more with Looting. None of them will bond.

pages.title: Barrow Shade
text: The dark caves under the Highlands, day or night, one to three at a time. Its blow weakens you for 4 seconds.
It drops **Barrow Shrouds**, a Weaken reagent.

pages.title: Pale Wraith
text: It flies over the Snow Fields at night, one or two at a time. From up to 12 blocks away it casts a chill that slows you for 3 seconds. Cover breaks the cast.
It drops **Wraith Veils**, a Chill reagent.

pages.title: Cinder Shade
text: It flies over the Ember Wastes at night, one or two at a time, and is **immune to fire**. From up to 12 blocks away it casts a bolt that sets you alight for 2 seconds. Cover breaks the cast.
It drops **Shade Embers**, a Bolt reagent.

pages.title: Drowned Shade
text: It rises in the water of the Shallows at night, one or two at a time. Its blow weakens you for 4 seconds.
It drops **Drowned Weed**, a Weaken reagent.
